name: RuleReviewPolicy
description: Manifest for `qctl apply -f`. Governs how submitted rule revisions are reviewed before they can be enabled: whether review is required, how many reviewers, and dry-run requirements. Omit spec.dataset_id for an org-level policy. See also: qctl guide review-rules.

properties.name: metadata
properties.description: Optional. metadata.name is a human label; metadata.id is set on round-tripped output.

properties.name: id
properties.description: Existing policy ID (present on `get -o yaml` output).

properties.name: dataset_id
properties.description: Target table (dataset) ID. Omit for an org-level policy.

properties.name: requires_review
properties.description: If true, a submitted rule revision must pass review before it can be enabled.

properties.name: min_reviewers
properties.description: Minimum number of distinct reviewers who must approve a rule revision.

properties.name: designated_reviewer_ids
properties.description: If set, only these reviewers' approvals count toward min_reviewers.

properties.name: dismiss_stale_reviews
properties.description: If true, existing approvals are dismissed when the rule revision changes.

properties.name: require_dry_run
properties.description: If true, a dry run must be linked to the review before the revision can be enabled.

properties.name: require_dry_run_success
properties.description: If true, the linked dry run must have passed before the revision can be enabled: finished, with no rule load errors and no rule-bug or sandbox failure.

properties.name: auto_enable_on_approval
properties.description: If true, an approved rule revision is enabled automatically.
